lines.zh: 我从最深的地方上来，一步一步。
lines.en: I come up from the deepest place, step by step.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，影子会多一个。
lines.en: An extra shadow appears where I pass.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很慢，可你甩不掉。
lines.en: My steps are slow, and you can't lose me.

lines.zh: 我的身体会跟着你的伤口变。
lines.en: My body changes with your wounds.

lines.zh: 你流了多少血，我就多硬。
lines.en: The more you bleed, the harder I get.
I circle a stone pillar.
I duck through a low doorway.

lines.zh: 我的影子先一步堵住门口。
lines.en: My shadow blocks the doorway first.
I follow it, slowly.

lines.zh: 这里的空气，让我更清楚。
lines.en: The air here sharpens me.
I walk the way you retreated.

lines.zh: 你身上的血味比上次更浓。
lines.en: Your blood smells stronger than last time.
I stand still and my shadow moves.

lines.zh: 我身上有鳞，一片压一片。
lines.en: I have scales, one over another.

lines.zh: 它们会随着你的痛收紧。
lines.en: They tighten with your pain.

lines.zh: 我从传送门里绕到你背后。
lines.en: I come through a portal behind you.
I'm counting your wounds.
Three? Or four?
Your hand is pressed to your ribs.
That one counts as one.
I am counting the breaths you have left.

lines.zh: 影子先动，我才跟上半步。
lines.en: The shadow moves; then I follow half a step.

lines.zh: 地上的石缝里，有东西在爬。
lines.en: Something crawls in the cracks.
I brought it.
I'm waiting for your knees.
The weaker you get, the faster I am.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只手，慢慢张开。
lines.en: I raise one hand and spread it slowly.
There's nothing between the fingers.
You're bleeding a lot. Good.
Your hand is on your ribs.

lines.zh: 你每掉一滴，我就重一分。
lines.en: Every drop makes me heavier.
That's the rule here.
You're still standing steady.
Then I'll wait a little more.

lines.zh: 我的影子比你先贴到墙上。
lines.en: My shadow reaches the wall before you do.
The lower your health, the heavier I hit.
There's no door in the wall.
I tilt my head and look at you.
You've dreamed this face.
You can't say where.
I remember that dream.
You were there that time too.
Now it's my turn.
I want to watch a while longer.
I'm waiting for you to kneel.
Once you kneel it's simple.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，鳞掉了几片。
lines.en: I step back and shed a few scales.
They're still moving on the ground.
The less blood you have, the harder I hit.
And you're bleeding too.
I do the arithmetic.
I still come out ahead.
A scale splits, yet I still laugh.
My scales close again.
You won't punch through.
Try again, by all means.
What's in your hand isn't blood.

lines.zh: 那点东西塞不住我的牙。
lines.en: That much won't fill my teeth.
I need what's on you.
You're pressing the wound.
Pressing won't stop it.
The blood keeps coming.
And I keep getting stronger.
That's my appetite.
Put your hand down.
Sooner or later, it's the same.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的胸甲，退开了。
lines.en: You hit my breastplate and fall back.
My scales shed the force.

lines.zh: 这一下，你手上多了道口。
lines.en: Now there's a cut on your hand.
The cut isn't a big one.
But it's bleeding.
I draw back and my scales close.

lines.zh: 我退开半步，等你再流血。
lines.en: I step back half a pace and wait for more blood.
My scales thicken slowly.
Can you see it?
It doesn't matter if you can't.
I came up from the deep.
There's nothing else down there.
Only shadows and echoes.
Listen to an echo long enough and it talks back.

lines.zh: 它说的都是你说过的话。
lines.en: It only says what you've said.
Then it started saying other things.
That echo is me.
So I don't need company.
I'm noisy enough on my own.
Do you hear that echo?
I lower my head and pick up a scale.
I shed that long ago.
I press it back into my arm.
The scale has taken hold again.

lines.zh: 掉下来的东西，我一片片捡。
lines.en: I gather every scale that fell.
I don't bother with those.
Picking them up won't make me stronger.
Only your blood does.

lines.zh: 我把脑袋从地上抬起来。
lines.en: I lift my head off the ground.

lines.zh: 我捏起一片鳞，收进掌里。
lines.en: I pinch up a scale and keep it in my palm.
Your wound is dripping.
The sound is very faint.
And I heard it.
I turn my head that way.
I see that drop.

lines.zh: 他从门里出来，我看见了他。
lines.en: He steps out of the gate; I have him.
A patch of ground hardens.
I set one foot on it.
The footing is very sure.

lines.zh: 你跑到哪儿，血会留在哪儿。
lines.en: Wherever you run, the blood stays.

lines.zh: 我踩着自己的影子跟过去。
lines.en: I follow along my own shadow.

lines.zh: 你一回头，我就从门里出来。
lines.en: You look back, and I step out of the gate.
I raise my hand to show you.
There's yours under the nails.
I look at him and smile.
That isn't a threat.
I follow the blood trail.
You took three turns.
The blood turned with you.
I don't have to guess at that.
You run ahead.

lines.zh: 你的心跳，在我耳边放大。
lines.en: Your heartbeat swells in my ears.
You're holding the wall.
Your handprints are on it.
I touch one.
My scales thicken a little more.
The weaker you are, the harder I land.
There's no need for me to be quick.
I'm ten paces behind you.
Five paces left.
The last six steps.

lines.zh: 他停下的地方，正好在门边。
lines.en: He stopped right beside my gate.
He turns to face me.
Your hand is pressed to the wound.
I sweep a claw across.
You block and go back two steps.
Your wound has reopened.
I feel myself grow heavier.

lines.zh: 爪子落下，地面塌了一块。
lines.en: My claws fall and the ground caves in.
That one you didn't block.
You're on the ground.
Blood is running out.

lines.zh: 我起跳，你身后多一道门。
lines.en: I leap, and another gate opens behind you.
My body is growing.
My scales lift one by one.
You've gotten very small.

lines.zh: 我的指爪伸向你的喉咙。
lines.en: My claws reach for your throat.
You grab my wrist.
I stand still, scales outward.
I don't move. I wait for you to let go.
I come up from the deepest place.
Step by step up the stone.

lines.zh: 每上一级，我就多一层鳞。
lines.en: Each step adds a layer of scale.

lines.zh: 到顶的时候，我已经很重了。
lines.en: By the top I'm very heavy.
I glance at the light outside.
The light outside is too bright.

lines.zh: 我把脑袋压低，缩起脖子。
lines.en: I lower my head and draw my neck in.
Until my eyes adjust.

lines.zh: 我从索尔阿克西斯最深处浮起。
lines.en: I rise from the deepest depths of Sol Axis.
Not fast. Steady.
That's not the walk of fear.
The less blood you have, the stronger I get.

lines.zh: 两道门在我身后同时打开。
lines.en: Two gates open behind me at once.
I follow the smell of blood.
My shadow goes first.
My shadow is always a step ahead.
It's already there.
I'm still on the steps.

lines.zh: 火在我鳞上烧，烧不进去。
lines.en: Fire burns on my scales and can't get in.

lines.zh: 我从石阶上滚下来，砸碎了一层。
lines.en: I roll down the steps and shatter a layer.

lines.zh: 水淹不到我，可它带走了你的血。
lines.en: Water can't drown me, and it carries your blood away.

lines.zh: 炸响掀开我的鳞，露出里面。
lines.en: The blast peels my scales back and shows what's inside.
An arrow lodges in a seam of scales.
That light is bright. I don't like it.
There's no blood to drink here.

lines.zh: 雷打进我的鳞里，我全身发亮。
lines.en: Lightning goes through my scales and I light up.

lines.zh: 我从哪儿来，就回哪儿去。
lines.en: I go back where I came from.
